defs.def: the period of sb's life when they are a child 童年；幼年；孩童时期

ex.s: “You don’t want to get fat” was on constant repeat throughout my childhood.
ex.t: “你不想变胖”这句话在我整个童年里被不断重复。

ex.s: My childhood was all about the pursuits I had attempted most of which had been chosen by Mom.
ex.t: 我的童年全是关于我尝试过的那些追求，其中大多数都是妈妈替我选的。

ex.s: Her childhood memory.
ex.t: 鼓励学生回答问题

ex.s: Ever since her childhood, Ginni, now 71, has had a deep love for travel.
ex.t: 从童年时起，现年71岁的金妮就对旅行有着深厚的热爱。

ex.s: A childhood dream.
ex.t: 一个童年梦想。

ex.s: Helping the next generation to have a healthy and active childhood is of great importance, and the industry is playing its part.
ex.t: 帮助下一代拥有健康而活跃的童年至关重要，而该行业正在发挥其作用。

ex.s: It made her childhood dream come true.
ex.t: 让她的童年梦想成真。

ex.s: What childhood experience gave Sullivan the idea to make free toys for kids? (no more than 15 words)
ex.t: 是什么童年经历让沙利文产生了为孩子们制作免费玩具的想法？（不超过15个单词）

ex.s: Why did the speaker feel lonely in her childhood?
ex.t: 演讲者为什么在童年时期感到孤独？

ex.s: To relive his childhood days
ex.t: 为了重温他的童年时光

ex.s: Why did the speaker feel lonely in her childhood?
ex.t: 为什么说话者在童年时感到孤独？

ex.s: Leslie Nielsen’s childhood was a difficult one, but he had one particular shining star in his life — his uncle, who was a well-known actor.
ex.t: 莱斯利·尼尔森的童年很艰难，但他生命中有一颗特别闪亮的星——他的叔叔，一位知名演员。

ex.s: Of all the stories of my early childhood, the one about a  36  is my mother’s favorite.
ex.t: 在我幼年的所有故事里，那个关于___36___的故事是母亲最爱的。

ex.s: her innocent childhood in the country
ex.t: 她在乡下的天真无邪的童年

ex.s: What did John enjoy doing in his childhood?
ex.t: 约翰童年时喜欢做什么？

ex.s: Her childhood dream.
ex.t: 她童年的梦想。

ex.s: childhood                         B. neighborhood
ex.t: 童年 B. 社区

ex.s: I had an interesting childhood.
ex.t: 我有一个有趣的童年。

ex.s: Angelou is best known for her series of seven autobiographies, which focus on her childhood and early adult experiences.
ex.t: 安杰卢以她的七部自传系列最为知名，这些自传聚焦于她的童年和成年早期经历。

ex.s: Pablo Picasso □ childhood □ family and friends □ books and films □ other artists □ history □ travel □ nature □ social issues □ private feelings □ culture and traditions □ imagination ＜R＞ What inspires you?
ex.t: 巴勃罗·毕加索（ Pablo Picasso ）□童年□家庭和朋友□书籍和电影□其他艺术家□历史□旅行□自然□社会问题□私人感情□文化和传统□想象力＜ R ＞是什么启发了您？

ex.s: From childhood on my heart and soul have been full of kindness, but for six years now, I have been forced to remove myself from society, to live life alone.
ex.t: 从童年开始，我的内心和灵魂就充满了善意，但六年来，我被迫脱离社会，独自生活。

ex.s: Li Ning 19, Shanghai, China I celebrated my 18th birthday just before I went to university.I expected to feel instantly different, as if I had closed the door on my childhood and stepped into a whole new adult world.
ex.t: 19岁的李宁，中国上海我在上大学前刚刚庆祝了我的18岁生日。我期待着立刻感觉不同，仿佛我已经关上了童年的大门，踏入了一个全新的成人世界。
